verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents its own managed connector framework for Computer, with "400+ services" and one-click OAuth, and the app advertises an Assistant that drafts emails and schedules appointments. That implies some email and calendar integration, but no source names cloud-drive, email or calendar connectors, or shows them being searched and cited in regular answers. Missing for 10: explicit drive/email/calendar connectors, evidence that connected data is searched and used in answers, hands-on corroboration.
